name: Bukkake!! 2 ~Rimi-chan Chako-chan Milk Mamire~
original_name: ぶっかけ!! 2 ～りみちゃんチャコちゃんミルクまみれ～
source:
"He's mine!" "What!? Don't steal him!" Kensuke and Rimi are old friends and boyfriend-girlfriend now. But Chako cuts in between them! "Well, it's my fate. Get out of my way!" "What are you talking about!? Get out of here!" "Well, don't fight..., please." "No!" "No way!" Like this, a battle for Kensuke begins....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090327124336/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1010134]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
"他是我的！""什么！？别把他抢走！"健介和莉美是相识多年的老朋友，如今已经成为恋人。然而，茶子却突然插入了两人之间！"哼，这就是我的命运。别挡我的路！""你在胡说什么！？快走开！""那个，拜托你们别吵了…""不行！""想都别想！"就这样，一场围绕健介的争夺战拉开了帷幕…

[摘自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090327124336/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1010134]ErogeShop[/url]]
